description: Themes: the features, capabilities, topics or whole apps currently in play, a layer above workstreams and below the long-term roadmap. Chrispian approves and sequences themes; agents may propose a theme (status proposed, then ready, meaning proposed and ready for the operator to consider, never authorized) and may park an approved theme with a reason, but never approve, reorder, finish or archive. The operator approves, resequences, finishes and declines (archive). Approved means eligible for sequencing only, never launch authorization: Torque tasks stay manual until promoted. This is the database formerly named priorities; its storage key and PR-nn legacy ids are unchanged. Progress (done/total tasks) is computed from the linked workstreams and tasks, never stored; a task counts as done only when its Torque status is done, and cancelled, abandoned and archived tasks leave the total.

id.description: stable id, prefix + slug; never reused

tldr.description: optional: one short paragraph. The central concept and the tension: what pulls different ways, what is at stake or undecided

source.description: where this came from, e.g. session date or message id

rank.description: order as given by the owner; lower is first. Not a confirmed ranking unless notes say so

status.description: Stored lifecycle. proposed: defined, not ready. ready: ready to be sequenced. approved: Chrispian approved it for sequencing (see order). paused: parked; its Torque tasks are untouched. done: finished; stays on the board for the landed window, then drops off. archived: off the board. Earlier values draft, active, achieved are still readable on unmigrated records. Flight-board words are derived for display and never stored.

rev.description: write counter, starts at 1, incremented by the service on every write; missing counts as 0

order.description: manual sequence among approved themes; lower first. The single sequencing mechanism. Changed only by the operator-only resequence action.

priority.description: 1 highest, 0 unset. Informational; sorts ready themes. Never ranks approved themes (order does).

author.description: who created the item (set by the service on create)

related_ids.description: generic link to item ids in any database

approved_by.description: who approved; set by the service on approve, never by a patch

approved_at.description: when approved; set by the service on approve, never by a patch

depends_on.description: ids of themes that must land first

tasks.description: direct Torque task ids counted in progress in addition to the tasks under workstream_ids

decision_ids.description: decisions waiting on or shaping this theme; the 'needs Chrispian' list, instead of free-text blockers

executing_owner.description: the agent or team doing the work

last_verified.description: when someone last confirmed this record matches reality; drives the age badge on the board
